<p>This modules provide an interface to libLLVMCore, which implements the LLVM intermediate representation as well as other related types and utilities. <a href="#details">More...</a></p>

## Description {#details}

<p>This modules provide an interface to libLLVMCore, which implements the LLVM intermediate representation as well as other related types and utilities.</p>


<p>Many exotic languages can interoperate with C code but have a harder time with C++ due to name mangling. So in addition to C, this interface enables tools written in such languages.</p>
